title: Flip in Blocks
statement:
A linked list is stored in `n` numbered nodes. Node `i` holds the value `v_i` and points to node `nxt_i` (`0` means no next node). The list starts at node `head` and passes through all `n` nodes exactly once.

Cut the list into consecutive blocks of `k` nodes, starting from the head, and reverse the order of the nodes inside every complete block. A last block with fewer than `k` nodes stays as it is. If the values of the resulting list are `x_1 ... x_n`, print `(1*x_1 + 2*x_2 + ... + n*x_n) mod 1000000007`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `head` and `k`. The second line contains `v_1 ... v_n`. The third line contains `nxt_1 ... nxt_n`.

## Output
Print the value described above.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 13000`
- `1 <= k`
- `0 <= v_i <= 10^6`
